searchText: Are Merkle proofs used anywhere apart from light clients? I was under the impression that dapps will require Merkle proofs to trust the data provided from JSON_RPC queries. Am I right? How do all dapps currently work? they are used in various places in dapps (airdrops, whitelists, zk proofs...), but not sure if you think that as part of "anywhere". Dapps are generally blindly trusting the JSON_RPC queries and they don't validate the results Can you expand how Merkle proofs are used in Airdrops, Whitelists, Zk proofs? google for "merkledrop" "merkle whitelist" "merkle vector zk proof"

excerpts.content:
Are Merkle proofs used anywhere apart from light clients? 

I was under the impression that dapps will require Merkle proofs to trust the data provided from JSON_RPC queries. Am I right? How do all dapps currently work?

excerpts.author: killari.
excerpts.content: they are used in various places in dapps (airdrops, whitelists, zk proofs...), but not sure if you think that as part of "anywhere". Dapps are generally blindly trusting the JSON_RPC queries and they don't validate the results
